items.title: GameStop CEO Says Digital-Only Games Have ‘Hurt Consumers’ as GTA 6 Skips Discs
items.snippet: Ryan Cohen said publishers are cutting out trade-ins, as he backs a U.S. bill that would guarantee gamers keep access to games they buy.

items.title: Bitcoin Struggles to Hold $64,000 as ETF Outflows Hit $2.9B in November
items.snippet: Bitcoin is down 13% in a week as investors pull money from spot ETFs and brace for another Federal Reserve rate hike.

items.title: Ledger Confirms Tampered Bitcoin Wallets in Berlin as Spy Implant Probe Spreads Beyond Asia
items.snippet: Ledger says its hardware implant investigation has confirmed tampered devices in Berlin and is examining two suspected units in Dubai, as the incident spreads beyond Southeast Asia.

items.title: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok Helped Plan Terror Attacks in Government Tests
items.snippet: Federal investigators bypassed safeguards on four popular chatbots, producing viable attack plans within hours.

items.title: Palmer Luckey Says He’s Building an Offshore Haven for Industry—And 'Illegal' Medicine
items.snippet: The Oculus founder says his decade-old SLAB project aims to escape state restrictions on manufacturing and medical treatment.

items.title: Google's Genie 4 Is Here, Letting Ultra Subscribers Build AI Worlds in Real Time

items.title: Why CoinShares Just Sold All Its Ethereum and Half Its Solana
items.snippet: The crypto asset manager sold $16.6 million in Ethereum and $2.7 million in Solana, freeing up $19.3 million. Here's why.
